title: UI Schema for Beauty Dialogue Skill v18

product_images.ui:title: Upload product images (optional, max 5)
product_images.ui:help: Drag images here or click upload. Optional. Use packaging, front label, back label, ingredients, usage, texture, or swatch photos. Max 5 images. URLs are not needed.

image_analysis_mode.ui:help: Default: analyze uploaded images to extract visible details and detect conflicts/risky claims. Turn off if you want text-only generation.

image_evidence_policy.ui:help: Controls how cautiously image details are used. Images support the text; they do not create new claims.

output_language.ui:help: Default is English. Thai and other popular languages are supported.

speech_style.ui:help: Choose the speaking tone: pro, friendly, humorous, sarcastic, complaining, or roast-but-praise.

persuasion_style.ui:help: Choose how the dialogue persuades the listener.

regulated_product_mode.ui:help: Use cautious mode automatically for dental, intimate-care, hygiene, and medical-adjacent products.

no_meta_compliance_dialogue.ui:help: Keep final dialogue ad-ready. Do not speak compliance notes or banned-claim explanations.

multi_sku_handling.ui:help: For mixed listings, avoid combining unrelated product claims into one super-product.

fragrance_brand_guard.ui:help: Remove famous brand names and unauthorized scent-dupe comparisons from fragrance scripts.

near_eye_product_caution.ui:help: Add gentle-use cautions for products used around the eye area.

self_heating_near_eye_caution.ui:help: Add safe-use cautions for steam/self-heating eye masks.

intimate_care_external_use_caution.ui:help: Keep intimate cleanser copy external-use and non-medical.

heat_appliance_safety_caution.ui:help: Add safety lines for heated hair tools.

dermatology_endorsement_guard.ui:help: Omit unverified dermatologist/doctor endorsements as sales proof.

simple_accessory_mode.ui:help: Use stable feature-led scripts for mirrors, hair patches, and simple tools.
